purpose: WebView2 lifecycle management: creates the browser environment, handles virtual host mappings for local assets, navigates to rendered HTML, and dispatches scroll/link messages from JavaScript.
invariants: Ready() is true only after environment creation, controller creation, and first navigation completion (ready_ && webView_ && documentLoaded_)
All WebView2 callbacks run on the UI thread via message pump (hidden message window)
pendingDocument* fields queue updates that arrive before WebView2 is ready
gotchas: WebView2 initialization is async — NavigateToString calls before Ready() are queued in pending* fields and applied in NavigationCompleted callback
PDF export requires ICoreWebView2_7; feature-checked at use time
SetVirtualHostNameToFolderMapping for the document root is updated on every new document to correctly resolve relative image/asset links in the edited file's directory
Reload() is called by PreviewWindow on WM_ACTIVATE to work around a blank render surface bug after window reactivation
